entities.summary: Asrafia Jame Masjid, previously known as the Mosque of Ahladi Bibi, is a Hanafi Sunni Friday mosque, located in the urban neighbourhood of Amlapara, in the city of Narayanganj, in the Dhaka Division of Bangladesh. It was built during the British Raj colonial period, dating from the 1890s CE.
